elements.label: Collect and validate email flow group (nodes, branches and connector from Start)

pattern.description: The whole 'Collect and validate email' flow group (instruction, condition, true/false branches, integration and continue nodes plus the connector from Start) appears at once next to the Start node, then settles with a slow, decaying drift while the cursor glides right.
pattern.why_premium: A complete, colour-coded flow lands in one beat on the word 'without', making the 'built for you' claim feel instant; the gentle follow-through drift keeps the frame alive instead of a static pop.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.flow-group', {autoAlpha: 0, x: 12, scale: 0.98}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.1, ease: 'none'}).to('.flow-group', {x: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<').to('.cursor', {x: 240, y: -50, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<');
build_hint.remotion: opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 3], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); const d = interpolate(frame, [0, 21], [1, 0], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); transform: translateX(${12 * d}px) scale(${1 - 0.02 * d}); cursor via interpolate with Easing.out(Easing.quad).

notes: Energy jumps at the 11th burst frame (f2186) and then decays slowly, so the group seems to appear almost instantly with a small settling drift; whether the nodes have a tiny internal stagger cannot be resolved from the filmstrip. camera.move is none, so no camera move is reported.
